# Gantt dependency lookups scan every edge for each task

Please comment to claim before starting and check the assignee and linked pull requests.

If this is still unclaimed on Thursday, November 19 at 09:00 UTC, I’ll check for work in progress and pick it up myself if it’s free. If you’ve already claimed it or opened a PR, please carry on. I’m available to review. — Emmy

## The problem

An application walking a chain through `Neo.gantt.DependencyStore#getPredecessors` and `getSuccessors` pays for every edge every time it asks about a task. On Engine `79f1de332a`, 64 calls on a 2,048-edge chain returned 64 edges and made **131,072** calls to `getAt`. Each lookup loops to `getCount()`. [Public store implementation](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/79f1de332aaebef485fb03da42b460e3bc5e46b9/src/gantt/DependencyStore.mjs#L96-L138)

To reproduce, use the real store setup from [Stores.spec.mjs](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/79f1de332aaebef485fb03da42b460e3bc5e46b9/test/playwright/unit/gantt/Stores.spec.mjs). Load 2,048 FS edges with `fromId: String(i)` and `toId: String(i + 1)` for `i = 0…2047`. Count calls to the instance’s original `getAt`. For each integer task ID from 1 through 32, call both lookup methods. Each call should return one edge.

## The change

Let the store answer repeated endpoint lookups from an index it owns. Keep the existing API: return a fresh array of the same matching record instances in current store order. Numeric and string forms of the same task ID match, and a missing or nullish ID returns an empty array. The current scan is the reference for those semantics. The chart’s native cascade already has separate traversal logic.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The chain reproducer returns exactly the same edge records and order. Instrument edge visits so repeated reads of unchanged membership show at most one full indexing pass plus work proportional to the results.
- [ ] Compare with the current scan after adding, removing, retargeting an endpoint, replacing data, sorting and filtering. Include an ordinary supported silent membership change so a caller can read the new graph before publication. A caller modifying a returned array cannot corrupt the next answer.
- [ ] Preserve the public method signatures and existing Gantt store, dependency creation and cascade tests. Put the regression beside the existing Gantt store specs.

Scope is the public dependency-store lookup API. This can be measured with the public chain fixture alone.

Latest 20 open issues, open/closed lookup and endpoint searches, matching assignments, recent lane claims and prior-art recall checked Nov 16. The Gantt family landed in #20878. The open backlog was 68 (red); no existing issue covered this lookup cost.
